Chemical Filtration and Advanced Lithography

Dockweiler has been a pioneer in the semiconductor industry from the very beginning. Since the early 1980s, with the rise of the first personal computers, we have specialized in stainless steel tubes and fittings for this industry. Our components are prefabricated in certified production environments, manufactured under ISO class 4, 6 and 8 clean room conditions and have electropolished inner surfaces with roughnesses of up to Ra
avg
. ≤ 0.25 µm, optionally even a maximum of 0.13 µm. Each item is 100% helium-tested for leaks - with leakage rates of 1 x 10-⁷ scc/sec for PCW and CFOS and 1 x 10-⁹ scc/sec for UHP products. Welding records, quality certificates, and complete traceability via heat number and material class are a matter of course for us.
Surface Treatment
For safe manufacturing processes, we offer specific inner surfaces from bright finished to electropolished. With our decades of experience in mechanical and electrochemical surface treatment and finishing, we offer the optimal quality for your applications. The continuous development of surface qualities is the result of innovative manufacturing processes and special solutions for customers. Our work in international professional organizations such as SEMI, EHEDG, AiF, GfKORR, and VDMA, as well as our participation in standardization work in ASME, ECISS, and DIN, provides further impetus. Regular audits document the high quality of our products.
> Mechanical processes: grinding, polishing
> Chemical processes: pickling, anodical cleaning and electropolishing
> Processing and finishing of special components
> Global electropolishing capacities
Stainless Steel Tubes & Fittings
Our standard products meet the highest requirements for surface quality and purity. They are used in the semiconductor industry, in the pharmaceutical industry, in analytics, and in other high-tech industries for the transportation of liquids and gases. Our tubes and fittings meet all common national and international standards and regulations.      Whether bright finished, pickled, or electropolished and packaged in our clean room – we have the right product for every application.   ...
Manifolds
Our manifold production combines innovation and precision to create optimal solutions for demanding processes. Perfectly customized to your individual needs.      From UHP, CFOS, and PCW solutions for the semiconductor industry to manifold systems for the pharmaceutical and food industry and cooling systems for data centers – our manifolds are essential for the efficiency and reliability of your processes. Manufactured with the highest precision, they enable uniform distribution of media and easy integration into existing systems.   ...
COAX – The Double-Wall Tube System
Our COAX double-wall tube system offers reliable and efficient solutions for highly viscous, toxic, explosive, or aggressive media in the semiconductor, chemical, and biopharmaceutical industries. With an inner process tube and an outer safety tube, COAX ensures maximum process reliability and avoids dangerous and cost-intensive leaks.      COAX tubes and fittings have an inner process tube and an outer safety tube between which, for example, a carrier gas reports leaks to a control room. Similarly, a pressure system can be connected that detects leaks via a sensor-based measuring device. This allows safety-critical media leaks, such as those of acids or hydrogen, to be reliably monitored and minimizes downtime. Viscous media can also be kept in a liquid form in the inner process tube by using a tempered outer tube.   ...

As part of the EBARA Group, the company develops and supplies innovative technologies that support the production of semiconductors, flat panel displays, photovoltaic devices, and other advanced electronic products. Its portfolio includes dry vacuum pumps, turbomolecular pumps, point-of-use abatement systems, chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) equipment, filtration technologies, ozone-related systems, and plating equipment.
Through continuous innovation, Ebara Precision Machinery Company helps customers improve manufacturing efficiency, reduce energy consumption, lower operating costs, and meet increasingly stringent environmental requirements. Its solutions are designed for critical semiconductor processes such as etch, deposition, diffusion, ALD, and other advanced manufacturing applications. The company also provides comprehensive lifecycle support, including installation, maintenance, rebuild services, parts cleaning, and technical field support through a global service network.
With decades of experience and thousands of installations worldwide, Ebara Precision Machinery Company is committed to delivering reliable, high-performance solutions that enhance productivity, maximize equipment uptime, and enable the next generation of semiconductor manufacturing technologies.

Based in Munich, Germany, with subsidiaries in Tokyo, Japan, and San Francisco, California, GenISys develops markets and supports flexible, high-performance software solutions for the optimization of micro- and nano- fabrication processes. Addressing the market for lithography and inspection, GenISys combines deep technical expertise in layout data processing, process modeling, correction and optimization with world class software engineering and a strong focus on ease of use for applications in IC prototyping, mask production, DfM development and MEMS. For electron- and laser beam direct write and mask manufacturing, our data preparation and proximity effect correction software helps to push the limits of technology. Since its foundation in 2005, GenISys has become a global market leader in the field of electron-beam lithography software and is expanding to related markets and applications.
BEAMER
BEAMER  is the premier layout data preparation software for electron-beam, laser, and optical lithography. It bridges CAD layout design and exposure tool execution, providing advanced pattern processing and Proximity Effect Correction (PEC) to maximize write speed, precision, and yield.  Key features include:   Advanced Fracturing & Data Prep:  Supports all major exposure tool formats and layout standards (GDSII, OASIS, CIF, DXF) with high-speed fracturing for complex curved geometries and photonic structures.   Proximity Effect Correction (PEC):  Features industry-leading 3D PEC, shape-dependent dose assignment, and process blur compensation for high-resolution nanolithography.   VisualFLOW™ Interface:  Modular, drag-and-drop flow design that automates complex multi-step data preparation pipelines and enhances reproducibility. LAB
LAB  is a comprehensive layout and process optimization platform for computational lithography and simulation. Designed to accelerate development and reduce production costs, LAB enables fast virtual exploration of large parameter spaces for projection, proximity, laser, and electron-beam lithography.  Key features include:   Multi-Technology Support:  Models projection, proximity, laser, and e-beam exposure tools within a single simulation platform.   Advanced Simulation:  Fast and accurate calculation of intensity images, aerial/bulk images, and 3D resist development modeling (including Mack4 and CAR models).   Optimization & Verification:  Supports Rule-based and Model-based Optical Proximity Correction (OPC), process window analysis (DOF, FEM, MEEF), and layout verification.   VisualFLOW™ Interface:  Intuitive drag-and-drop workflow creation with powerful 1D, 2D, and 3D visualization and automated metrology capabilities. ...
TRACER
TRACER  is an advanced Monte Carlo simulation software designed to quantify electron-solid interactions and perform precise process calibration for electron-beam lithography. It enables users to accurately model electron scattering, analyze energy distribution, and generate essential Point Spread Functions (PSFs) required for effective Proximity Effect Correction (PEC).  Key features include:   Monte Carlo Simulation:  Rapidly computes electron scattering across arbitrary material stacks, accounting for primary and secondary electron spread and trajectory visualization.   PSF Management & Analysis:  Extracts 1D/2D PSFs, supports multi-Gaussian model fitting, averaging, and convolution, and seamlessly integrates with BEAMER for streamlined PEC workflows.   Advanced Process Calibration:  Determines critical parameters such as base dose, process blur, process bias, and lateral development using measured critical dimension (CD) data.   Extensive Material Library:  Includes a comprehensive built-in database of common semiconductors, metals, insulators, and resists, with easy creation of custom materials. ...
ProSEM
ProSEM  is an advanced SEM metrology and automation package designed for fast, accurate measurement and analysis of micro- and nanostructures, process calibration, and lithographic patterns.  While modern lithography tools are highly automated, SEM-based metrology and inspection often remain manual and time-consuming. ProSEM provides an easy, automated, and reliable measurement solution for R&D institutions, multi-user facilities, and specialized manufacturing environments.  Key capabilities include:   Automated SEM Metrology:  Automated image analysis, line-width/CD measurement, line-edge roughness (LER), and contact hole analysis.   Process Calibration & Optimization:  Integrates seamlessly with simulation and PEC workflows to extract real-world process bias and parameters.   High Efficiency & Reproducibility:  Eliminates manual, operator-dependent measurement errors and streamlines data collection for fast batch processing. ...
InSPEC

It provides comprehensive solutions for multi-chip, large-area monitoring and high-throughput data processing. Founded in 1984, Heidelberg Instruments is a global leader in the design, development, and production of high-precision laser lithography systems, maskless aligners, and nanofabrication tools. The company has established itself as a trusted partner and solution provider for both industry and academia, with more than 1,500 systems installed worldwide and over 40 years of expertise in advanced lithography and direct-write technologies for micro- and nanofabrication.
The portfolio ranges from compact tabletop systems for R&D and small-series production to advanced photomask manufacturing equipment for high-volume production. Our solutions enable a broad spectrum of micro- and nanoscale patterning applications, supporting both high-resolution 2D structuring and the creation of complex 2.5D topographies through grayscale lithography. By combining precision, flexibility, and automation, Heidelberg Instruments helps customers accelerate innovation while reducing development costs and time-to-market. Typical application areas include photonics, electronics and sensors, semiconductors and advanced packaging, displays, quantum devices, MEMS, microfluidics, 2D materials, and photomask production.
Empowering Semiconductor Innovation: Heidelberg Instruments’ precise lithography tools support semiconductor manufacturing and research by addressing critical lithography processes across development and production. The industrial maskless aligner systems can be fully integrated into modern machine execution systems including SECS/GEM with GEM300 support as well as OPC/UA. These capabilities enable high-precision reticle fabrication, maskless exposure, adaptive patterning, and alignment for multilayer devices and advanced packaging.
In India, Heidelberg Instruments is represented by Labindia Instruments Pvt. Ltd. Labindia is exhibiting at Booth #976.

IntelliSuite which is a key semicon software is capable of design and simulation of Microfabrication and packaging process until Multiphysics. This is in combination with MEMS and EDA. It is the only software tool that caters these needs in a single platform. Hence, it is one of the key semicon software.
3D Advanced Package Simulation
IntelliSuite caters the needs of optimising the 3D advanced packaging. The novelty of this feature is that the packaging recipe is designed using process simulation and further taking device through the Multiphysics analysis. This will help to understand the effects of process deviation that may affect the device.
The simulation helps anticipating the errors that may arise during modeling and its impact on the packaging using thermal-electrical-mechanical simulation.
Microfabrication Simulation: Silicon & Beyond
IntelliSuite software offers design and simulation modules that are critically essential for realizing the device. It has materials more than 300 and an option to add new materials by the user community.

overview2:
Protect yield with audit-ready cleanroom garment s
Built for fabs, OSATs and high-tech component plants
In electronic and semiconductor manufacturing, even the smallest disturbances can become expensive defects. Lindström helps fabs, OSATs, and high-tech component plants reduce particle and ESD risk with a controlled garment lifecycle, audit-ready traceability, and reliable local service.
What is a sterile gowning procedure and why is it
Learn what a sterile gowning procedure is, why it matters in cleanrooms, and how it supports contamination control, GMP compliance, and patient safety.
Why biotech facilities need high-quality cleanroom
Biotech facilities operate in highly controlled environments where cleanliness, safety, and process reliability are essential. Whether a facility is involved in research, vaccine development, cell culture, diagnostics, sterile manufacturing, or biologics production, contamination control is one of the most important priorities. Even a small amount of dust, fiber, moisture, or microbial contamination can affect product quality, test results, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.

Maxell’s Advanced SLIONTEC Tape Series
Maxell’s Advanced SLIONTEC Tape Series for Semiconductor Manufacturing
Maxell proudly introduces its latest lineup of high-performance adhesive tapes
designed specifically for semiconductor wafer and package dicing, as well as back
grinding protection. The SLIONTEC series—comprising the No.636000 Dicing Tape for
wafers, No.636015 Dicing Tape for packages, and No.635249 Back Grinding Tape—
oRers cutting-edge solutions to enhance precision, yield, and environmental safety in
semiconductor manufacturing processes.
No.636000 Dicing Tape (for Wafer)
This tape features a higher isotropic olefin backing combined with a UV peeling
adhesive, optimized for various wafer dicing applications. It delivers strong adhesion
(2.80 N/10mm) and excellent holding power under heat (40℃), ensuring wafers remain
securely fixed during processing. The environmentally sensitive adhesive contains no
solvents and is free from toluene/xylene, supporting cleaner manufacturing
environments. The tape’s design allows full usage to the end, reducing material waste
and rejects.
No.636015 Dicing Tape (for Package)
Tailored for package dicing, this tape shares the same advanced backing and UV
peeling adhesive technology as the wafer tape. It provides consistent adhesion and
holding power, facilitating reliable fixation of packages during dicing. Its solvent-free,
eco-friendly adhesive composition enhances safety and sustainability in production
lines. The tape’s standard type classification makes it a versatile choice for diverse
package dicing needs.
No.635249 Back Grinding Tape
Designed to protect bumped wafers during back grinding, this tape prevents dimples
and wafer damage with its high conformity to bumps approximately 300μm in diameter.
Available in UV and non-UV types, the non-UV version features an initial adhesion of
0.25 N/10mm, ensuring secure wafer protection without compromising surface
integrity. Like the dicing tapes, it employs an environmentally sensitive adhesive free
from harmful solvents.
Common Benefits Across the SLIONTEC Series
•
Environmentally sensitive adhesives with no solvents, toluene, or xylene
•
High adhesion and holding power for secure fixation
•
Full tape utilization to minimize waste and rejects
•
Clear application guidelines to ensure optimal performance
•
Designed to meet demanding semiconductor manufacturing standards
Maxell’s SLIONTEC tapes represent a significant advancement in adhesive technology
for the semiconductor industry, combining performance, environmental responsibility,
and cost-eRiciency. These products support manufacturers in achieving higher yields
and improved product quality while adhering to stricter environmental regulations.
For more information on Maxell’s SLIONTEC tape series and technical support, please
visit Maxell’s oRicial website.

Rotarex is a global company that designs and manufactures premium quality gas control products and systems. Founded in Luxembourg 100 years ago, the company has grown to be a world-leading producer of cylinder valves, pressure regulators, equipment and fittings that deliver superior gas safety, control and productivity. Thanks to top-tier European engineering and technical excellence developed over decades, Rotarex is a valued partner of many of the world's most demanding gas companies and gas system designers and installers.
Rotarex creates applied innovations through its rapid response R&D infrastructure and collaboration with university partners that solve real customer challenges and invent new ways of working. Driven by this culture of innovation, Rotarex holds over 100 patents and has developed many breakthrough products that are now industry standards. With 15 logistics centers, 30 service centers and presence in 65 countries,

Roxtec India Pvt. Ltd. provides innovative modular cable and pipe sealing solutions that protect critical infrastructure from multiple hazards. Our certified sealing systems ensure safety, reliability, and operational continuity by protecting cable and pipe penetrations against fire, water, gas, dust, vibration, electromagnetic disturbances (EMI/EMP), and rodent ingress.

overview2:
SCHNEEBERGER Group supplies renowned original equipment manufacturers (OEM) worldwide in a wide range of industries, from Semiconductor to the medical, machine tools, electrical industries, and robotics, photonics among others.
Linear bearings, profile linear guideways, integrated measuring systems, gear racks, slides, positioning systems, ball screws and mineral casting are all part of the product and manufacturing range.
As a global, financially and technologically solid family-owned company, make a significant and sustainable contribution to the success of our customers. Our high-quality, high-precision products and our reliable delivery play a key role in the successful development, production, and sales of products in this future-oriented market.
Discover SCHNEEBERGER's Precision motion solutions
SCHNEEBERGER will participate in SEMICON India 2026 from September 17–19 at Yashobhoomi (India International Convention & Expo Centre) in New Delhi. Visitors can meet the SCHNEEBERGER team in Hall 1, Booth 1668.
Under the theme Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem, SEMICON India will bring together companies, specialists and decision-makers from across the global semiconductor ecosystem. The event provides a platform for dialogue around the continued development of India’s semiconductor industry.
At its booth, SCHNEEBERGER India will demonstrate its expertise in precision motion technology for semiconductor applications. Highlights include customer-specific positioning and motion systems, MINIRAIL and MINI-X miniature linear solutions, the SAM absolute measuring system and MINISLIDE MSQscale with integrated guiding and measuring functions. Visitors will also be able to experience the brand’s German engineered positioning systems with their systems stage showcase.
SEMICON provides an important opportunity to connect directly with customers and industry professionals and exchange ideas on the motion and positioning challenges shaping the next generation of semiconductor equipment. SCHNEEBERGER’s India team will be available throughout the three-day event to discuss specific application requirements and future projects with visitors.
Stop by booth 1668 and discover precision solutions for your next innovation.
Experience Swiss precision positioning technology
As semiconductor equipment becomes more sophisticated, machine builders face increasing demands for precision, compact integration and reliable motion. At SEMICON India 2026, SCHNEEBERGER India will present technologies designed to address these requirements across a wide range of semiconductor applications.
Visitors to Hall 1, Booth 1668 can explore customer-specific precision positioning and motion systems, supported by SCHNEEBERGER’s engineering expertise from individual components to integrated solutions. The systems stage showcase will take centre stage and provide a closer look at the possibilities offered by precision positioning technology.
Additional highlights include MINISLIDE MSQscale, which combines guiding and measuring functions in a highly integrated design, as well as the SAM – SCHNEEBERGER Absolute Measuring System. HIPP precision-ground ball screws will further complement the solutions presented at the booth.
Beyond the technologies on display, the SCHNEEBERGER India team will be available to discuss individual application requirements and explore suitable approaches for current and future semiconductor equipment.

Global Platform for Legacy Semiconductor Equipment & Parts
SurplusGLOBAL is a leading global provider of legacy semiconductor equipment, parts, and asset management solutions with over 26 years of industry experience. Headquartered in Korea and operating across the United States, Japan, China, Taiwan, Singapore, and Europe, SurplusGLOBAL has built a trusted network of more than 6,000 semiconductor companies in over 60 countries.
The company specializes in equipment sales, purchasing, refurbishment, rental, remarketing, valuation, and parts sourcing, supported by one of the world's largest semiconductor equipment facilities and extensive global sourcing capabilities.
SurplusGLOBAL is also the developer and operator of SemiMarket, an AI-powered global marketplace designed specifically for the legacy semiconductor ecosystem. Built on industry data, AI-driven matching, and a worldwide network of fabs, OEMs, refurbishers, and equipment owners, SemiMarket helps companies efficiently buy, sell, source, and manage semiconductor equipment and parts globally.
Customer Story · SemiMarket Remarketing
SJ TECHNOLOGY Streamlines Used Semiconductor Parts Sales with SemiMarket Remarketing
Selling used semiconductor parts is not simply about listing inventory and waiting for buyers. It requires warehouse space, product photography, detailed item information, pricing decisions, sales channel operation, buyer communication, and inventory management.
SJ TECHNOLOGY
, a specialist in semiconductor equipment and parts refurbishment, is using SemiMarket Remarketing to manage what was once a complex used parts sales operation in a more structured and efficient way.
SurplusGLOBAL Secures Korean Patents for AI-Powere
SurplusGLOBAL (CEO: Bruce Kim) announced that it has secured Korean patents covering two core technologies implemented within its global semiconductor equipment and parts marketplace, SemiMarket (www.SemiMarket.com): Demand & Supply Predictive Matching and Global Transaction Risk Management.
SurplusGLOBAL Secures Korean Patents for AI-Powered Export Control Automation Technology, Strengthening Safety in Semiconductor Equipment and Parts Transactions
SurplusGLOBAL Secures Korean Patents for AI-Powered Export Control Automation Technology, Strengthening Safety in Semiconductor Equipment and Parts Transactions
The significance of these patents lies in their approach to treating export control compliance and transaction efficiency as complementary objectives rather than separate processes. Through its proprietary ECP AI Agent (Export Control Program AI Agent), SurplusGLOBAL integrates counterparty verification, export control risk assessment, and demand-supply matching into a single workflow, enabling SemiMarket users to transact more efficiently while maintaining compliance standards.
SemiMarket's 600,000-SKU Scale: AI Managing Compliance and Matching Simultaneously
SemiMarket currently hosts approximately 600,000 semiconductor equipment and parts SKUs. Each item contains numerous compliance-related variables, including ECCN classifications, specifications, transaction history, end-user information, and destination countries. In addition, transactions must account for constantly evolving global export control frameworks, including the U.S. Department of Commerce Entity List, EU sanctions regulations, and Korea's Strategic Trade Control regulations.
Managing such a large volume of product information and complex regulatory requirements entirely through manual review presents significant operational challenges. As transaction volumes grow, review times and administrative burdens increase, potentially leading to transaction delays and compliance risks. To address these challenges, SemiMarket applies the ECP AI Agent to automate export control review and transaction matching processes, improving both transaction speed and compliance management.

Lead Frame and EDM wire

Our lead frames are manufactured with materials such as Copper Alloys and Nickel Alloys like Alloy 42 for high-reliability applications. Our manufacturing capabilities include both precision stamping for high-volume production and chemical etching for intricate, high-density designs      EDM Wire  Precision Redefined for Lead Frame Manufacturing  We provide the SumiSpark γ EDM wire, a solution specifically engineered to meet the uncompromising requirements of lead frame production. By leveraging a high-carbon steel wire core paired with a proprietary special alloy coating, we deliver a product that balances high-tensile strength with exceptional electrical discharge performance.  In the semiconductor industry, precision is the ultimate priority; therefore, our wire is available in ultra-fine diameters ranging from 0.03mm to 0.10mm. These specifications facilitate high-speed, ultra-precise processing while maintaining the critical stability needed for intricate lead frame geometries. Choosing our EDM wire ensures a more efficient production cycle, superior surface finishes, and the reliability required for next-generation electronic components. ...
Probe Card Pins
We provide high-precision tapered probe card pins engineered for the most demanding semiconductor testing requirements.    By utilizing a proprietary mechanical grinding process instead of conventional etching, we achieve superior tip accuracy and the ability to process specialized precious metal materials including Tungsten (W), Rhenium Tungsten (ReW), Palladium Alloy (Pd), and Beryllium Copper (BeCu). Our fully integrated in-house production covering everything from wire drawing and heat treatment to final bending and allows us to deliver custom-tailored solutions with optimized material properties for maximum reliability and performance.        ...
Probe Card
We provide a comprehensive range of high-performance probe cards and probe heads designed to act as the critical interface between test equipment and semiconductor wafers. Our solutions support diverse validation and mass production requirements,  offering advanced Vertical Probe Cards and integrated probe head assemblies for high-density testing that minimize pad damage and improve parallelism. ...
PCB & PCBA Testing products
Wire Probes    Designed for fine-pitch chip, IC pacakages and wafer inspections, ultra-fine wire probes enable high-precision testing in tight spaces where standard pins fail. Featuring 0.02mm–0.110mm diameters and lengths down to 4.5mm, they use specialized Tungsten, BeCu, and Pd alloys to ensure low, stable contact resistance and high oxidation resistance.       Jumper Wire    Jumper wires act as flexible, short-cut connections on printed circuit boards, allowing electricity to bypass standard wiring to bridge remote parts of a circuit. By simply adding or detaching these conductors, engineers can control power, turn specific functions on or off, repair damaged board traces, and easily test design updates without the high cost of manufacturing a completely new PCB.                         ...

ULVAC is a leading Japanese provider of vacuum technologies and manufacturing solutions that support the global semiconductor and electronics industries. Founded in 1952, the company develops and supplies production equipment, vacuum pumps, thin film deposition systems, analytical instruments, materials, and lifecycle services. Its core expertise in vacuum engineering enables the precise manufacturing processes required for advanced electronic devices.
In the semiconductor sector, ULVAC supplies equipment used in critical wafer fabrication processes, including physical vapor deposition (PVD), sputtering, chemical vapor deposition (CVD), etching, ion implantation, plasma processing, and native oxide removal. These technologies are essential for producing memory chips, logic devices, power semiconductors, sensors, and other high performance components. By helping manufacturers achieve smaller feature sizes, improved yields, and greater production efficiency, ULVAC supports innovation in artificial intelligence, IoT, cloud computing, automotive electronics, and advanced computing applications.
ULVAC also makes significant contributions to the broader electronics industry. Its vacuum and thin film technologies are used in the manufacture of display panels, electronic components, batteries, solar cells, and advanced materials. These solutions enable the production of smartphones, consumer electronics, electric vehicle systems, and next generation displays.
With a global presence and strong focus on research and development, ULVAC continues to advance manufacturing technology through innovation, process expertise, and customer support. The company plays an important role in strengthening semiconductor supply chains and enabling the development of more efficient, reliable, and high performance electronic products worldwide.

overview2:
Why humidity measurements matter in semiconductor
In semiconductor manufacturing nothing matters more than accuracy. From microchip fabrication to the final assembly of integrated circuits, every step in the process requires precise measurements for high-quality, repeatable results. One of the most critical parameters to measure is humidity, as maintaining exactly the right moisture levels is crucial for optimal equipment performance and end-product quality.
Silicon wafer polishing and cleaning
Silicon wafer polishing and cleaning is a key step in semiconductor manufacturing. The process involves high humidity and harsh chemicals that can cause sensor drift, making accurate measurement even more of a challenge.
Probes for this type of environment need to withstand both high humidity levels and exposure to harsh chemicals. One excellent solution is the
Compact Temperature and Humidity Probe HMP9
, which is a compact device with a very fast response time. It can withstand high humidity levels and also has a chemical purge function for post-contamination sensor cleaning. For machine or tooling manufacturers Vaisala also offers modular humidity and temperature products such as the
Relative Humidity and Temperature Module HMM170
, which can be integrated into end products.
Wafer steppers, coating, and developing machines
Wafer steppers that coat and develop silicon wafers are laser-based so even the smallest ambient variations can significantly affect process quality. The ambient pressure, relative humidity, and temperature all influence optical behavior and lens focus, and this must be monitored and compensated for in real time. When working in nanoscale, precisely measuring and monitoring these parameters becomes even more critical.
One excellent solution for these machines is the modular
Vaisala Indigo520
, which offers pressure as an optional measurement parameter. The
humidity and temperature probe HMP3
is compatible with the Indigo520 and features a structure that allows the sensor to be replaced in the field without tools, making it ideal for cleanroom environments. For processes that need to monitor other parameters, such as CO2 and dew point, a range of other probes are available. Whichever you choose, the probe can be connected to a central transmitter such as the Indigo520, giving you the flexibility to choose the best combination for your process.
Wafer dicing and probing machines
The wafer dicing process, where individual chips are separated from the wafer, needs accurate humidity measurement to protect both the product and the machines. Condensation can be an issue, particularly when the tape is peeled off, so dew point needs to be monitored carefully. During probing, chips are subjected to extreme temperature variations to test integrated circuit performance. This process demands precise control of dew point and humidity to prevent condensation and rust formation in the test chambers.
Vaisala offers several compact devices for monitoring and controlling these parameters. There is the
DMT143 Miniature Dew Point Transmitter
, which covers a wide measurement range from -70°C to +60°C for frost and dew point. Another option is the Vaisala
Dew Point Transmitter DMT152
, which is optimized for ultra-dry conditions and offers frost point measurements as low as –80°C with +/– 2°C accuracy. Both products feature autocalibration, ensuring very long calibration intervals, and are easy to integrate into any OEM application like semiconductor manufacturing machines or testing devices.

Visit ZESTRON at SEMICON India – Booth H5829
Discover how ZESTRON is enabling the next generation of semiconductor manufacturing through advanced cleaning and surface conditioning technologies. As a global leader in precision cleaning solutions, we help OSATs, IDMs, EMS providers and their supply chain eliminate surface contamination, improve manufacturing yields and achieve the stringent cleanliness and reliability requirements of advanced electronic assemblies.
Our application-specific solutions support SMT, Power Electronics, and Advanced Packaging, including SoP, Flip Chip, Ball Attach, SiP, 2.xD, stacked 3D packages, Chip-on-Wafer (CoW), wafer bumping and high-power devices. Our advanced chemistries are engineered for critical cleaning, surface conditioning, and oxidation control to enable robust, high-reliability manufacturing processes.
Visit Booth H5829 to meet our technical experts and learn how ZESTRON can support your process development, qualification and production requirements. Explore our capabilities in customer-specific cleaning trials, process optimization, analytical testing and reliability evaluation backed by our Bangalore Technical Center which is equipped with state-of-the-art cleaning equipment and analytical capabilities. Supported by a local engineering team with over 15 years of industry experience, we work closely with customers to solve complex manufacturing challenges and develop reliable, production-ready cleaning processes.
Whether you're introducing a new package, optimizing an existing process, or addressing critical cleanliness and reliability challenges, visit ZESTRON at Booth H5829 to discover practical solutions that improve manufacturing performance, product reliability and time-to-market.
